settings.remove.title: Remove Kleaner
settings.remove.what: Erases all Kleaner data: the log and preferences (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Kleaner and %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.swaksm.kleaner folders). Kleaner then closes.
settings.remove.exe: Kleaner is portable: there is nothing else to uninstall. Then just delete the kleaner.exe file.
settings.remove.irreversible: The log will be permanently lost. Your files and programs are not touched.
disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.does: Kleaner scans your drives and shows you what takes up space, hidden files included.
disclaimer.never: It never does anything without your confirmation. It never touches your passwords, cookies, sessions or the registry.
disclaimer.network: No Internet connection: nothing is sent, no telemetry.
disclaimer.caches: Caches and temporary files are permanently deleted (they rebuild themselves). Your personal files always go to the Recycle Bin.
disclaimer.journal: Every action is written to a readable log: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kleaner\journal.log.
disclaimer.license: Free software under the MIT license, provided without warranty. You remain responsible for what you delete.
journal.intro: Everything Kleaner did on this PC, newest first.
